table.name: TLGNR_ORDER_REP_ATT_TYPE_BS
table.description: Stores attachment types to reference by TLGNC_ORDER_REP_ATT (repair order attachment table).

column.name: ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK, which should be one of: 1) offer 2) doku 3) invoice 4) email

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
